Definition: an elder (Aramaic); the aged, the elders
BiblicalUsage: Sib is the Aramaic word for the elders, the aged men who lead the people, and all five of its occurrences are the elders of the Jews in Ezra's day. The eye of their God was upon them while they built, the governor was told to let the work alone and let the elders build the house of God in its place, and they built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God watches over His elders while they build, because the eye of God was upon them and no letter could stop the work.
